properties.title: Chapman's Peak Road Closure
properties.description: Road closed due to wave action topping the seawall. Reopens when seas subside.

properties.title: Power Outage – Mitchells Plain
properties.description: Unplanned outage affecting approximately 4,000 homes. Storm damage to substation. ETA restoration: unknown.

properties.title: N2 Flooding – Sir Lowry's Pass
properties.description: N2 partially flooded. Single lane open. Expect heavy delays. Trucks advised to avoid.

properties.title: Fibre Outage – Atlantic Seaboard
properties.area: Sea Point / Green Point / De Waterkant
properties.description: Openserve fibre outage affecting residential and business customers. Underground cable damaged by flooding.

properties.title: Flash Flooding – Strand / Gordon's Bay
properties.description: Flash flooding across the R44 corridor. Vehicles stranded. Rescue teams deployed. Residents in low-lying areas urged to evacuate immediately.

properties.title: Gale Force Winds – Cape Peninsula
properties.description: Gusts exceeding 100 km/h recorded at Cape Point. Flying debris reported. Hikers and cyclists advised to stay off exposed paths.

properties.title: R44 Closure – Stellenbosch Direction
properties.description: R44 closed in both directions near Lourensford Road due to debris and surface flooding. Use N2 via Somerset West as alternate.

properties.title: Flood Damage – Citrusdal
properties.description: Significant flood damage reported in Citrusdal following the storm system. Roads damaged, properties flooded in low-lying areas. Cederberg Municipality assessment teams on the ground.

properties.title: Water Pipe Burst – Bellville CBD
properties.description: Major water main burst on Voortrekker Road. Repairs underway. Water pressure reduced across Bellville and Parow. Expect disruptions until 20:00.

properties.title: Storm Surge Warning – Table Bay
properties.description: Storm surge of 0.8m above predicted tide level expected between 15:00–18:00. Low-lying coastal industrial areas at risk of inundation. Port Cape Town operating under restricted conditions.
